title: Chapter 107 The Fuse
content:
Chapter 107 The Fuse

The next day, just as Sun Jian received that His Majesty the Emperor had wiped out the main force of the alliance in the northwest, and was preparing to send troops to completely wipe out the remaining forces in the northwest, the news in the northwest was very good!

After notifying the generals of the army, the morale of many generals and officials in the army was boosted. Among them, Tian Feng, the supervisor, proposed to inform the whole army of the news to boost morale.

For this proposal, Sun Jian was extremely reluctant. He had obtained the method of fighting qi cultivation at this moment, and his own strength was expected to go further.

In the army, many generals are from his Jiangdong lineage, and even many of them are the old troops he brought out when he quelled the Yellow Turban Rebellion.

People such as Cheng Pu Handang, Huang Gai Zumao, or Zhu Zhi Wu Jing, together with his own family brother Sun Jing, etc., nearly half of the entire Southwest Route Army was controlled by them, forming an army headed by Sun Jian. interest groups!

In addition, Sun Jian and Lv Bu got very close recently, and they agreed that Sun Ce, the eldest son of the Sun family, would marry Lv Bu's eldest daughter as his wife. Recently, Sun Jian's words in the entire army may be more important and more useful than Zhong Yu's edict!

As for the behavior of forming cliques and colluding with each other to form interest groups in the military, Zhong Yu has long known that even this kind of behavior was encouraged and allowed by him in private. The soldier situation happened.

In order to pacify the Three Kingdoms world as soon as possible, Zhong Yu had to compromise with the warlords of many aristocratic families and gave up a lot of benefits in exchange for their support. Even the army under his command now was only able to be formed with the support of those aristocratic families with money and food.

In return for their support, Zhong Yu gave up most of the commanding power of this army and handed it over to those generals from aristocratic families to lead them.

And Zhong Yu just picked out 50,000 soldiers with cultivation talents to form his personal guard army, titled Yulin Army, Yu is the name of Zhong Yu, and it also means to rule, Lin means many lush Together, Zhong Yu's rule is as prosperous as a forest.

These 50,000 people Zhong Yu will directly teach the cultivation method. This exercise is a quick way for Zhong Yu to exchange with the system, so that the system can be combined with the practice of various military formations in the heavens and ten thousand realms. Practice, as long as you continue to fight and kill the enemy, and experience wars, you will be able to continuously break through in the battle and quickly improve your cultivation.

And the side effects have been systematically deleted and modified, and the advantages and disadvantages of each exercise are integrated, and become extremely slight. It is a collection of many battlefield exercises for Dacheng to practice!

For Zhong Yu, these 50,000 soldiers and horses are all the foundations for him to rule the heavens and worlds in the future, and they must never be transferred to others. Therefore, no matter the choice of these 50,000 soldiers or the appointment of generals, Zhong Yu will directly Select poor orphans without any family background foundation:

These people don't even have family members, and all their relatives either died or were abandoned since they were young. They don't have any worries or fetters, which is very beneficial for Zhong Yu to brainwash and cultivate loyalty!

All the education they receive and the training they receive every day are all about instilling loyalty to Zhong Yu, and continuous practice to gain greater strength, these two ideas and thinking!

As for other knowledge cultivation, there are also special people to train them to enrich their knowledge and mind, so that they will not just become mere soldiers, and can provide greater help for Zhong Yu in his future battles!

But there is only one core idea in all the training, that is to be loyal to Zhong Yu, and take their emperor's order as the highest criterion, and they must not violate it no matter what!

And it has been mentioned before that when Zhong Yu was just practicing, he had already input a trace of true energy with his own aura. In addition to reducing their training time, in order to achieve the results of cultivation faster, and increase their true energy Qi power outside.

It can also be used to continuously influence their subconsciousness through the inner energy, and instill their own loyal thoughts deep in their hearts, which can be said to be extremely secretive and thoughtful!

In this way, with the inner and outer influences, those soldiers now worship Zhong Yu to the extreme.

And Zhong Yu has these 50,000 soldiers who are completely loyal to him, regard himself as the most important person in his heart, and have stopped practicing the method of cultivation. He has a trace of true energy bestowed by himself in his body, and his strength has initially reached the second-level soldier. Have the confidence to suppress all dissatisfaction with oneself in the territory.

This is also the reason why he didn't care about the other 350,000 cannon fodder at all, and said before those generals set out to spend it at will, and he didn't care about his own punishment.

It is because most of these soldiers are in the second degree of obedience to their own orders, and their first loyalty is often to their army commander, which belongs to the state of a lord's lord, not my lord, how can this be tolerated by Zhong Yu Woolen cloth!

In the Three Kingdoms World before, in order to unify the whole world as soon as possible, a compromise had to be made, and then in order to have enough troops to help him quickly pacify the many small tribes in the entire Eder Tribal Alliance, so he had to make so many unreasonable things. Listen to your own soldiers and horses!

Now is the time when these cannon fodders come in handy. I kept them for so long, didn't I just want to use them to find out how deep the water of the gods in this world is? How big is the threat to yourself!

Now using their lives to fill the pits of the barbarian's extraordinary power is just complementing each other. At the same time, it can also be repaired. The number of generals who are growing under their own will reduce their strength so that they can understand who is the emperor? Who the hell is their master?

Therefore, when the commanders-in-chief of the various armies went out, the supervisors sent by Zhong Yu had instructed them before they left to do their best to obtain more troops during the expedition without affecting the victory or defeat. They don't hesitate to damage the various soldiers under the command of their army commander.

All of this must be grasped to a certain degree, just like winning a war, the general cannot pursue it for the sake of the overall situation, and the supervising army forces the general to use the lives of the soldiers to expand the results of the battle and obtain greater benefits, regardless of Those soldiers are likely to suffer from the predicament.

Now Sun Jian, being persecuted by Tian Feng, who carried out Zhong Yu's order, had to send out Yu Guo soldiers who were already similar to his private soldiers, risking the loss of his own strength, biting the bullet to fight this war that was destined to suffer heavy losses.

At the same time, regarding this, Sun Jian complained more deeply about the supervising army who had been against him, and about the emperor who appointed the army. He often complained in front of his confidant generals, complaining that the emperor didn't trust him so much, and his behavior was extremely rebellious!

After accumulating over time, the momentary heart of conspiracy was buried, and after receiving the fighting qi skills contributed by those small tribes, he saw a future leading to a broader road, and the ambition in his heart was even more burning.

All of this has become a trigger, and until this day, Tian Feng's persecution again, coupled with the discussion between the previous chief Wolf and his gods, will it become the trigger to ignite everything?

Everything depends on today's battle!
